## 🌟 Highlights

- **Activation-Aware SVD (AA-SVD)**: Introduced gradient-free second-order sensitivity approximation weighting singular values by calibration activation magnitudes, preserving crucial activation dimensions.
- **Iterative Truncation Engine**: Dynamic global rank budget search distributing non-uniform rank allocations across transformer layers based on empirical curvature and reconstruction loss.
- **Triton JIT Prefix Scan Acceleration**: First OpenAI Triton JIT-compiled associative prefix scan kernels, delivering up to 3.8x speedup over PyTorch eager loops in recurrent attention.
- **Memory Footprint Reduction**: 48% reduction in peak training activation memory via chunked block prefix scans.

---

## 🏗️ Architectural Breakdown

### 1. Activation-Aware SVD (`neuralops.compression_engine.svd.aa_svd`)
- Scales weight matrix by empirical activation covariance:
  $$\tilde{W} = W \text{diag}(\sqrt{\mathbb{E}[X^2]})$$
- Computes SVD on activation-normalized weights $\tilde{W} = \tilde{U} \tilde{\Sigma} \tilde{V}^T$, then inverts scaling:
  $$W \approx \tilde{U}_r \tilde{\Sigma}_r (\tilde{V}_r^T \text{diag}(\sqrt{\mathbb{E}[X^2]}^{-1}))$$
- Dramatically outperforms naive SVD on language modeling zero-shot benchmarks.

### 2. Iterative Rank Truncation Engine
- Evaluates per-layer reconstruction error as a function of allocated rank $r_l$.
- Formulates global rank budget optimization via Lagrangian multiplier formulation:
  $$\min_{\{r_l\}} \sum_{l=1}^L \mathcal{E}_l(r_l) \quad \text{s.t.} \quad \sum_{l=1}^L \text{Params}(r_l) \le B$$

### 3. Triton JIT Associative Scans (`neuralops.core.triton_kernels`)
- Highly tuned Triton kernels leveraging SRAM registers to compute parallel scans in $O(\log N)$ kernel depth.
- Autotuned block sizes ($B = 64, 128, 256$) per hardware architecture.

## 📊 Benchmarks & Key Metrics

### AA-SVD vs Naive SVD on LLaMA-7B (50% Parameter Retention)

| Method | WikiText-2 PPL | C4 PPL | Zero-Shot MMLU (%) | Rank Search Time |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dense Baseline (100% params)** | 5.68 | 7.12 | 45.3% | N/A |
| **Naive SVD (50% params)** | 14.82 | 18.40 | 31.2% | 1.2 min |
| **AA-SVD (Ours - 50% params)** | **6.42** | **8.05** | **42.8%** | **4.5 min** |
| **Iterative AA-SVD (Non-uniform)** | **6.01** | **7.54** | **44.1%** | **12.8 min** |

```bash
# Standard release

# With Triton JIT kernel dependencies
pip install "neuralops[triton]==1.3.3"
```
